exercises.title: Implement the Core Operation
exercises.description: Implement a reusable function that applies the central idea from statistics for machine learning.
requirements: Validate empty or invalid input where relevant.
Return a result rather than printing from the function.
Do not modify caller-owned input unless the task explicitly requires it.
exercises.starter_code:
def solve(data):
    # TODO: validate the input
    # TODO: implement the core operation
    pass
hints: Work through one small example by hand first.
Break the task into input validation, computation, and return value.
Test both normal and edge cases.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Return a correct result for a simple non-empty input
Handle empty input according to a documented rule

exercises.learning_outcome: Turn a concept into a reusable, testable function.

exercises.title: Inspect and Explain Results
exercises.description: Use a small dataset to produce a result and write a short interpretation.
requirements: State the shape and types of the input.
Calculate or report at least two relevant summaries or metrics.
Explain what the result means and one limitation.
exercises.starter_code:
# TODO: create or load a small dataset
# TODO: inspect its shape, types, and basic properties
# TODO: compute relevant summaries
# TODO: write a 2-3 sentence interpretation
hints: Do not interpret an output before checking its inputs.
Consider whether an unusual value changes the summary.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Code runs and produces documented summaries

exercises.learning_outcome: Connect computational output to a careful explanation.

exercises.title: Mini-project: Reproducible Workflow
exercises.description: Build a small end-to-end workflow using the concepts from statistics for machine learning.
requirements: Use a deterministic or documented dataset.
Separate data preparation from the main computation.
Check at least one edge case or failure mode.
Print or return a concise result summary.
Write one limitation and one next experiment.
exercises.starter_code:
def run_workflow(data):
    # TODO: validate and inspect data
    # TODO: prepare data without leaking evaluation information
    # TODO: run the main analysis
    # TODO: return results and relevant metadata
    pass
hints: Start with a baseline or simple summary.
Use a small test before scaling up.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Workflow completes, returns a result, and documents its assumptions

exercises.learning_outcome: Combine lesson skills into an interpretable, reproducible workflow.
